title: Implement strStr()
description: Find the first occurrence of a substring using sliding window.

data.text: Implement `strStr()`. Return the index of the first occurrence of `needle` in `haystack`, or `-1` if `needle` is not part of `haystack`.

data.title: Window check O(n * m)
KMP O(n + m)
What improved?
data.text: KMP precomputes the longest prefix-suffix table so the needle never moves backward. This avoids redundant comparisons when partial matches fail.
